faqs.q: Sec. 98-68. - Reports by vendor; payment of tax.
faqs.a:
Every vendor shall be liable as a taxpayer and responsible for the reporting to the
               finance director and paying the tax at the rate of 3.46 percent of the gross total
               of taxable sales or charges for service during the reporting period, plus any excess
               tax collected on sales or charges for service. Unless otherwise approved by the finance
               director, the reporting period shall be as follows: annually for a taxpayer whose
               yearly net tax is less than $100.00; quarterly for a taxpayer whose average monthly
               net tax due is less than $60.00; monthly for a taxpayer whose average monthly net
               tax due is $60.00 or more. Such report shall be made and tax paid under the provisions
               of this article on or before the 20th day of the month following the reporting period.
               A timely payment shall be evidenced by the city cashier validation date. Any due date,
               payment date, or deadline for paying the total tax liability or providing information
               or taking other action, which falls on a Saturday, Sunday or legal holiday established
               by title 5 U.S. Code § 6103, shall be extended to the first business day following
               such weekend or holiday. A report shall be made for each place of business if more
               than one location is used in the business of sales at retail within the city. The
               taxpayer may submit a written request annually to the finance director to use a reporting
               period different than that specified herein. The finance director may in his sole
               discretion grant such a request if he finds that there is reasonable cause to do so
               and that the change will not jeopardize collection of the taxes due. If any taxpayer
               who is on a quarterly reporting period fails to file any return or pay any tax when
               due, he may be given notice by the city to file returns and pay taxes on a monthly
               basis, and the taxpayer shall do so from and after the date of the said notice.
(Code 1981, § 31-43; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002; Ord. No. 3980, § 1, 12-12-2005;
